description: Private five-stage, evidence-grounded research manuscript creation and peer-review workflow for ChatGPT, inspired by Google Research's PaperOrchestra.

defaultPrompt: Create a research paper from my idea and experiment logs using all five roles. Ask me only for essential missing material.
Review my current manuscript as a strict journal reviewer, verify citations, and give a prioritized revision plan.
Convert my research results into figures, tables, and a target-venue LaTeX manuscript.
interface.longDescription: Build and revise evidence-grounded manuscripts using a five-stage ChatGPT workflow: outline, plots, literature review, manuscript drafting, and critical peer review. Supports real research inputs, LaTeX and venue templates, verified references, and transparent quality checks.

name: research-paper-orchestra
